packageRules.description: Group the pinned Ansible collections into one PR and auto-merge patch/minor once CI is green; majors stay manual. requirements.yml is matched above so these bumps run the full integration test.

konstruktoid roles change the hardening surface: keep them as individual, human-reviewed PRs (no auto-merge). Per-role PR titles are also required by deps-new-version-test.yml, which greps the title to pick the test playbook and rewrite the pinned SHA.
